name: Explain pharmacological properties and medical uses of drugs
description: Users requested detailed pharmacological and medical information about specific drugs, including their mechanisms of action, indications, side effects, administration routes, and regulatory standards. Many queries focused on general drug classifications, safety profiles, and technical aspects of pharmaceutical preparation or testing rather than personal dosage advice.
